title: Scalpa Recalls Scalpa Numb Maximum Strength Topical Anesthetic Cream Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Packaging Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The product contains the substance lidocaine which must be in child resistant packaging as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act (PPPA). The packaging of the product is not child resistant, posing a risk of poisoning to young children. Units: About 10,000.

title: Belkin Recalls Portable Wireless Chargers + Stand Special Edition Due to Fire and Shock Hazards
summary: A manufacturing defect in the power supply unit can cause the charger to malfunction and overheat, posing fire and shock hazards. Units: About 2,280.

title: Juratoys Recalls Toy Trumpets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The small plastic pieces inside the toy trumpets can come loose and can be ingested by children, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 2,457 (In addition, about 622 were sold in Canada).

title: Sea to Summit Recalls Camping Pots Due to Burn and Scald Hazards
summary: The nylon latch can disengage from the pot and cause the handle to detach, posing burn and scald hazards. Units: About 16,200 (In addition, about 2,050 were sold in Canada).

title: John Deere Recalls Frontier Rotary Tillers Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Some PTO drivelines were assembled without a specified safety sign. The safety sign explains the associated hazards and that an operator or bystander can become entangled if there is contact with the driveline. Units: About 1,740 (in addition, about 140 were sold in Canada).

title: Noble House Home Furnishings Recalls Chests, Cabinets and Dressers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: The recalled chests, cabinets and dressers are unstable and can tip over if not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. title: Academy Sports + Outdoors Recalls Ozone 500 Density Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The locking hardware on the front wheel can become loose resulting in front wheel instability, posing fall and injury hazards. Units: About 6,000.

title: Massimo Motor Sports Recalls Percussion Massage Guns Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Costco
summary: The lithium-ion battery system can overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 12,360.

title: Rust-Oleum Recalls Aerosol Paint Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The bottom of the pressurized container can detach unexpectedly, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 10,500.

title: CB2 Recalls Junction Tall Chests and Low Dressers Due to Tip-Over and Entrapment Hazards
summary: The recalled chests and dressers are unstable if they are not anchored to the wall, posing serious tip-over and entrapment hazards that can result in death or injuries to children. Units: About 11,000 (in addition, about 355 were sold in Canada).

title: Rapala USA Recalls Rechargeable Fillet Knives Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The battery can overheat and catch fire if non-Rapala chargers are used to charge the battery. Units: About 128,000.
